title: 第570章 恼羞成怒喔第569章 闲谈
content_zh:
艾什被后巷的城防卫队士兵超过，他们把艾什保护其中，并分出两名士兵带着艾什离开后巷，其余的士兵们则持续推进，逼着那几个精灵放下手里的武器，跪地投降。
那些精灵们最终也没有反抗，他们已经逃不掉了，也只能放弃抵抗，纷纷按照士兵们的呵斥与命令被抓捕，刚才那股嚣张的气焰不复存在了，垂头丧气的手脚挂上了锁链。
艾什抱着胳膊去看热闹，八个精灵有几个恶狠狠地瞪了艾什两眼，不甘地被城防卫队士兵们带走，士兵们又分开两条路，巷口带走精灵，巷尾则给高精灵女军官让路。
那高精灵女军官走到艾什面前，查看了下艾什脸，尤其主要观察了艾什的眼睛和穿着，面露和煦的微笑，和刚才冷硬完全不同。
“小姐，没有受伤吧？”她开口说着，犹豫中给艾什行了抚胸礼。
艾什不是很想多和眼前的高精灵女军官多聊什么，但是对方肯定也不会放自己离开，完全不想行礼的她站在原地抱臂膀，简单敷衍地回答。
“感谢你的关心，我没事，那么，我可以走了吗？”
高精灵女军官看出了艾什的平淡和芥蒂，见艾什没有还礼，大概在猜想艾什的身份，表面上略显尴尬，挥手命令城防卫队士兵把精灵们带回城堡，接着转过身，打理了下她的小斗篷，向艾什主动伸出右手。
“还希望小姐能够和我一起回到城防卫队驻地，我想更加了解一下事情的经过，我是洛瑞安城的城防卫队的指挥官，你可以叫我伊妮丝.瑞莉丝格尔.科林菲芮，高精灵。”
艾什望着女军官伊妮丝伸出的手，她皱了皱眉，看来对方是不会给艾什离开的机会了，只能故意烦躁地叹气，伸出手简单和伊妮丝握在一起，抬头冷脸抿嘴，憋出一句话。
“艾什戴薇尔.弗洛斯特.......伊格斯......你可以叫我弗洛斯特。”
本想说出全名的艾什，再想到真名很重要这点，又临时加了个胡乱想到的姓氏，不知道伊妮丝会不会相信艾什的假话，她重重握手，把艾什的手都捏的有些发痛才松开，背着手昂起下巴，和煦的笑着。
“那么，弗洛斯特小姐，和我回驻地，怎么样？”
“我还是更想回去，而且我的同伴在担心我，我已经在街上乱转两个小时了。”
“那我陪你回去怎么样？即使是外来的旅者，我们洛瑞安城防卫队也有责任和义务来保护！”
“......”
艾什是彻底没办法了，眼前的女人一丝不苟的样子，使得艾什短时间没法甩开她，只能抿嘴勉强答应，灰暗着眼神往旅馆那边走去。
伊妮丝大步走在艾什身侧，她那张看起来极力想要在民众面前表现善意的脸，弄得艾什不适，她要是光闭嘴不说话还好，这家伙边走边问艾什一堆问题。
“那么弗洛斯特小姐是哪里人呢？来到洛瑞安是旅行？看你的穿着，应该是某个贵族的小姐吧？”
暗中用余光去看伊妮丝的艾什，注意到伊妮丝在说贵族小姐这句话时，嘴角稍微扬起一个高度，像是.....在骄傲，或者，嘲弄？自己看错了？艾什眨眨眼，没太放在心上，在冷风中哈气。

“嘶......呼.......中线某个国家的普通人而已......路过洛瑞安，没多久就会离开你的国家。”
“弗洛斯特小姐不要紧张，我只是简单问问，你的朋友都是做什么的呢？”
“旅行者。”
“这样吗？旅行者或许没有你有钱吧？50金币的首饰随心购买，对于路过的平凡店铺你都不会往里面多看一眼。”
这话说出，艾什感觉不太对劲，这女人想说什么，是......在取笑我花钱奢侈吗？这家伙的神态和语气以及穿着，不也是贵族么？怎么会问出这样的话？
“......”疑惑不已地艾什挑起眉毛，看了眼伊妮丝，没有选择回答，更多的是疑惑。
“你的种族很奇特，弗洛斯特小姐，银白的头发，白皙的肌肤，还有红色的眼睛和蛇瞳，是血族吗？”
伊妮丝说着话的时候，眼神不由自主瞟向艾什的蛇瞳，并且眼底中那一抹艾什绝对不会看错的厌恶，使得艾什对伊妮丝的好感骤降，稍稍皱眉，简单嗯了声。
“人类，大概.......”
艾什的回答显然没有得到伊妮丝的满足，她停顿了几秒，很不礼貌地仔细观察艾什的头发和脸，上下打量一番，才又恢复看起来平易近人的模样问下去。
“夜纱低语会的精灵为什么会说可能认识你呢？以前和他们接触过吗？”
“啧......”
艾什不再前行，她转头盯着伊妮丝的脸，这该死的婊子语气里都是陷阱和刻薄，她在用她的权利与地位来碾压艾什，这种贵族常用的小伎俩，或者说习惯，艾什可见多了。
伊妮丝看起来只是简单的询问，在艾什听来，实际上是对于艾什的无形审讯，还有对艾什可能同为贵族的攀比，但是她到底想攀比什么？
自己他妈的就是穿的好一些，我还没有心情听你在这里嘲弄，她决心不想听伊妮丝在耳边唠叨，左手叉腰，右手摊手，表情忍住厌恶，保持着不想惹麻烦的心态说道：
“伊妮丝......指挥官，首先，我和我的朋友路过你们的国家，沿途遭遇了魔物的袭扰，匪帮的劫掠，我应该是无辜的受害者，而不是和他们站在一起，对你美丽的城市吐口水。”
“我说实话，在来到洛瑞安前，我就杀了不止一个你口中的夜纱低语会的匪徒，最初，我只以为他们是一群暗精灵河匪，谁又能想到他们还有你们高精灵，或者什么其他奇怪的精灵混在其中。”
content_en:
Ash was overtaken by the city defense soldiers in the back alley. They protected Ash and separated two soldiers to lead Ash out of the back alley. The remaining soldiers continued to advance, forcing the elves to put down their weapons and kneel down to surrender.
The elves did not resist in the end. They could no longer escape, so they had no choice but to give up resistance. They were arrested one after another according to the soldiers' scoldings and orders. The arrogance just now no longer existed, and their dejected hands and feet were hung with chains.
Ash folded his arms to watch the excitement. Several of the eight elves glared at Ash fiercely, and he was reluctantly taken away by the city defense soldiers. The soldiers separated into two roads, taking away the elves at the entrance of the alley, while making way for the high elf female officer at the end of the alley.
The high elf female officer walked up to Ash and looked at Ash's face, especially her eyes and clothes. She had a warm smile on her face, which was completely different from the coldness just now.
"Miss, you're not hurt, are you?" she said, and hesitantly gave Ash a breast massage.
Ash didn't really want to talk to the high elf female officer in front of him, but the other party would definitely not let her go. She didn't want to salute at all and stood there with her arms folded and gave a simple and perfunctory answer.
"Thank you for your concern. I'm fine. So, can I go?"
The female high elf officer noticed Ash's plainness and grudge. Seeing that Ash didn't return the favor, she was probably guessing Ash's identity. She looked a little embarrassed and waved her hand to order the city defense soldiers to take the elves back to the castle. Then she turned around, smoothed her little cloak, and extended her right hand to Ash.
"I also hope that the young lady can return to the city defense station with me. I want to know more about what happened. I am the commander of the city defense team in Lorien City. You can call me Inis Rilisgar Colin Ferry, the high elf."
Ash looked at the outstretched hand of the female officer Inis, and she frowned. It seemed that the other party would not give Ash a chance to leave. He could only sigh deliberately irritably, stretched out his hand and simply shook it with Inis, raised his head and pursed his lips coldly, holding back a sentence.
"Ashedevil Frost...Eggs...you can call me Frost."
Ash, who originally wanted to tell his full name, then thought about the importance of his real name, so he temporarily added a random surname. Not sure if Inis would believe Ash's lie, she shook hands hard, squeezing Ash's hand until it hurt a little before letting go, holding her hands behind her back and raising her chin, smiling warmly.
"Then, Miss Frost, how about returning to the station with me?"
"I'd rather go back, and my companions are worried about me. I've been wandering the streets for two hours."
"Then how about I accompany you back? Even if they are foreign travelers, our Lorien City Defense Force has the responsibility and obligation to protect them!"
"..."
Ash was completely helpless. The meticulous look of the woman in front of him made him unable to get rid of her for a short time. He could only purse his lips and reluctantly agree, and walked towards the hotel with gloomy eyes.
Inis strode beside Ash. Her face, which looked like she was trying her best to show kindness in front of the people, made Ash uncomfortable. It would be better if she just shut up and didn't speak. This guy asked Ash a lot of questions as he walked.
"So where is Miss Frost from? Are you traveling to Lorien? Judging from your dress, you should be a lady of some noble family, right?"
Ash, who secretly looked at Inis with his peripheral vision, noticed that when Inis said these words to the noble lady, the corners of her mouth were raised slightly, as if... she was proud, or mocking? Did you see it wrong? Ash blinked, not taking it too seriously, and breathed in the cold wind.
"Hiss... Huh... Just ordinary people from a country on the middle line... Passing by Lorien, you will leave your country soon."
"It's okay Miss Frost.Zhang, I just want to ask briefly, what do your friends do? "
"Traveler. "
"Is that so? Travelers may not have as much money as you, right? You can buy as much jewelry as you like for 50 gold coins, and you won’t even take a second look inside any ordinary store you pass by. "
After saying this, Ash felt something was wrong. What was this woman trying to say? Was she... making fun of my extravagant spending? Doesn't this guy's demeanor, tone of voice, and clothes also make him a noble? How could you ask such a question?
"..." Ash raised his eyebrows in confusion and glanced at Inis. He didn't choose to answer, but was more confused.
"Your race is very strange, Miss Frost. You have silver hair, fair skin, and red eyes with snake pupils. Are you a vampire? "
When Inis was speaking, her eyes involuntarily glanced at Ash's snake eyes, and there was a look of disgust in her eyes that Ash could never mistake. Ash's affection for Inis dropped sharply, and he frowned slightly and simply hummed.
"Humans, probably..."
Ash's answer was obviously not satisfied by Inis. She paused for a few seconds and looked at Ash's hair and face very impolitely. She looked up and down before returning to her approachable appearance and continued to ask.
"Why did the elves from the Yesha Whispering Club say they might know you? Have you had contact with them before? "
"Tsk..."
Ash stopped moving forward. She turned her head and stared at Inis's face. This damn bitch's tone was full of traps and meanness. She was using her power and status to crush Ash. Ash had seen this trick, or habit, commonly used by nobles.
Inis seemed to be just asking a simple question, but to Ash's ears, it was actually an invisible interrogation of Ash, as well as a comparison that Ash might be a noble, but what exactly was she trying to compare with?
She is just better dressed. I am not in the mood to listen to your mocking here. She was determined not to listen to Inis nagging in her ear. She placed her left hand on her waist and spread her right hand. Her expression held back her disgust and she maintained the mentality of not wanting to cause trouble and said:
"Ines...Commander, first of all, my friends and I passed through your country and were attacked by monsters and plundered by gangs along the way. I should be an innocent victim, instead of standing with them and spitting on your beautiful city. "
"To be honest, before I came to Lorien, I killed more than one bandit from the Nightshade Whispering Society you call me. At first, I only thought they were a group of dark elves and river bandits. Who would have thought that they also had you high elves or other strange elves mixed in with them. "
